09 / GOOD TO KNOW

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you offer a mobile remapping service?+

Yes. RemapWorks UK provides mobile ECU remapping and diagnostics across Birmingham and the West Midlands. Send your postcode and vehicle details to confirm appointment availability and which work can be carried out at your location.

Will my vehicle be suitable for remapping?+

Suitability depends on the engine, ECU, transmission, condition and existing modifications. Send your registration and vehicle details so we can assess the options.

How much does remapping cost?+

Starting prices are: Stage 1 ECU remapping — Starting from £199; Stage 2 / Stage 2+ — Starting from £250; Gearbox / TCU flashing — Starting from £199. Other listed services — Starting from £120, with the final price confirmed for the work required. A vehicle-specific quote confirms scope and price before booking.

What is the difference between Stage 1 and Stage 2?+

Stage 1 typically considers a standard vehicle. Stage 2 usually requires compatible supporting hardware. The specification must be assessed for each vehicle.

Will I need to tell my insurer?+

Tell your insurer about any proposed modification and obtain their agreement before proceeding. Check any finance, warranty or lease conditions too.

Can you guarantee power or fuel savings?+

No fixed gains or savings are promised. Outcomes vary with vehicle condition, specification, fuel and driving style.

Do you offer DPF, EGR or AdBlue deletion?+

We offer enquiries for diagnostics and compliant repair solutions. We do not advertise road-vehicle emissions defeat or unsafe removal of safety restrictions.

Where do you cover?+

Birmingham and the West Midlands. Contact us with your location to confirm availability and the service arrangements.

Does this form send my enquiry automatically?+

The form prepares your enquiry in a messaging window. Review it and press Send to complete your enquiry. Opening the window does not confirm receipt or a booking.
